{{Quote|Open the gate, Gungan.''"<br />"''No! Mesa no betrayin' Otoh Gunga!''"<br />"''You will open the gate.''"<br />[hypnotized] "''Mesa&hellip; open gate.|Darth Maul and Ganne at the Gates of Rellias|audio=MaulControlsGanne.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The '''Gates of Rellias''' were the gates that protected the [[Rellias Straits]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] used the captured [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Ganne]] to open the gate. In doing so he let the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] use the Rellias channel.

==Description==
{{Quote|Now we must find the Gates of Rellias somewhere to the southwest.|Darth Maul, after capturing Boss Ganne|audio=MustFindRellias.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The Gates of [[Rellias]] were a trio of gates located in the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Rellias]] on<ref name="GB" /> the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="GB" /> One gate was located on the western entrance to Rellias, another in the middle of the city, and the last in the southern exit leading towards the [[Rellias Straits]],<ref name="GB" /> which connected to [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]] and [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]], the [[Gungan society|Gungan]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]].<ref name="End Game">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref> The gates were used to repel intruders but could be opened by the command of [[Ganne]], the [[Boss/Legends|boss]] of Rellias.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|We must find the encampment to the southeast and capture the Gungan leader. He is the only one who can lead us to the gates of the Rellias channel. I must capture him personally.|Darth Maul|<ref name="GB" />}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] launched an [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and sought to [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|conquer]] the Gungan [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] was tasked with finding Otoh Gunga,<ref name="GB" /> and discovered that Boss Ganne was key to doing so. After capturing Ganne with the support of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]], Maul [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricked]] him into both revealing that they needed to pass through the Rellias Straits to access Otoh Gunga and giving them access to the city through the gates.<ref name="End Game" /> At the gates, Ganne attempted to resist Maul's orders to open them, but the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] was able to extend the effectiveness of his mind trick to do so. After passing through the gates and eliminating the Gungan forces in Rellias, the Droid Army reached Otoh Gunga,<ref name="GB" /> only to discover that it had been evacuated in response to their attack on Rellias.<ref name="End Game" />
